name: Tzimtzum

phase_0.boundary_condition: The primordial vacuum (Halal) established by the withdrawal of the infinite light.

VINIT.justification: The undifferentiated infinite state preceding any distinction or emanation.

TANCH.justification: The residual impression of the infinite light that remains as a boundary within the vacuum.

AFWD.justification: The thin line of light that descends into the vacuum to initiate creation.

AREV.justification: The contraction of the infinite light back toward its source to create space.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of divine attributes as vessels for the light.

IMSCRIB.justification: The infinite recognizing its own capacity to be finite through internal constraint.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the divine emanation into the distinct qualities of Mercy and Severity.

FFUSE.justification: The reconciliation of Mercy and Severity into the central pillar of Beauty.

EVALT.justification: The successful flow of light into the vessels.

EVALF.justification: The failure of the vessels to contain the light, leading to the shards.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence and absence of the infinite within the finite space.

IFIX.justification: The permanent fixation of the material world as an append-only record of emanation.

phase_3.void_description: The pre-tzimtzum state where no space or distinction exists.
phase_3.true_description: The successful emanation of light into structured vessels.
phase_3.false_description: The collapse of vessels and the descent into chaotic shards.
phase_3.both_description: The state of the vacuum containing both the absence of light and its residual impression.

steps.domain_action: Ein Sof exists as absolute undifferentiated unity.
The infinite recognizes the potential for finite existence within itself.
The infinite light withdraws from a central point toward the periphery.
The resulting vacuum (Halal) is established as a permanent site for creation.
The Reshimu remains as a trace boundary within the vacuum.
The Kav (line of light) penetrates the vacuum from the infinite source.
The light divides into the specific archetypes of Mercy and Severity.
Mercy expands to provide the substance of the emanation.
Severity contracts to provide the form and boundaries of the vessels.
Mercy and Severity unite to form the balanced structure of the Sefirot.
The Sefirot chain together to form the four worlds of existence.
The system holds the paradox of the infinite inhabiting the finite.
The final world of Action is fixed as a physical reality.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Divine Will (Ratzon) which translates infinite intent into finite structure.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The flow of the Kav (line) through the various levels of the Sefirot.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Reshimu (residue) which preserves the memory of the infinite within the vacuum.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The emanation sequence (Seder Hishtalshelut) which dictates the order of descent.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Torah as the blueprint or primordial code for the structural emanation.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The concealment of the infinite light (Hester Panim).
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Structured finite existence containing hidden infinite light.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The total light is conserved but redistributed through concealment and revelation.
